floorBasis: User confirmed on 2026-11-24; level changes remain explicit in the route.
coverage: Recorded entrance-to-Lab-H journey only; not a complete floor plan.

source.method: Visual inspection of extracted video frames; audio not transcribed. Timestamps are approximate review references, not walking times.

waypoints.label: Science Centre entrance
waypoints.instruction: Start at the glass doorway shown at the beginning of the recording. The user confirms this is the entrance to use from Gate A.

waypoints.label: Main staircase
waypoints.instruction: Go up the staircase ahead, following the turning landing and the second flight to the upper landing.

waypoints.label: Upper landing and counter
waypoints.instruction: Follow the landing beside the metal railing to the curved counter. Join the corridor extending past the counter and blue noticeboard.

waypoints.label: Corridor with glass partitions
waypoints.instruction: Continue along the corridor, passing the glass partitions and the blue noticeboard. Other room labels are not reliably readable in this recording.

waypoints.label: First descending steps
waypoints.instruction: Use the descending steps beside the red patterned screen and handrail, then continue along the corridor.

waypoints.label: Middle corridor
waypoints.instruction: Continue along the corridor past the doors on both sides toward the next section of steps.

waypoints.label: Second descending steps
waypoints.instruction: Use the second short section of descending steps beside another red patterned screen.

waypoints.label: Lab corridor
waypoints.instruction: Continue beyond the steps. Look for the wooden double doors on your left with glass panels.

waypoints.label: Lab H — Biomedical Research Lab
waypoints.instruction: Identify the door by the LAB H / Biomedical Research Lab sign. Stop at the doorway; entry permission is not established by this video.
